article.title: Dora Akunyili
article.extract: Dora Nkem Akunyili was a Nigerian pharmacist and politician who served as the director-general of National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) of Nigeria from 2001 to 2008.

turns.explainer_raw:
Dora Akunyili was a Nigerian woman who ran NAFDAC, Nigeria's food and drug agency, and fought fake medicines. My message reads: Nigerian woman, pharmacist; food and drug agency boss; fights counterfeit pills.
